Apple yesterday launched two brand-new Watch models: Apple Watch Series 12 (pre-order) and Apple Watch Ultra 4 (pre-order). And the latest discovery shows that each of the two models has a surprise upgrade Apple didn't mention: double the memory compared to the previous generation.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12 have double the memory of last year's models

One of the most exciting changes in the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 is the all-new S11 chip that powers both.

The S11 brings the first meaningful performance upgrade to the Apple Watch in years, and it comes at just the right time, accompanying a suite of AI features in watchOS 27.

But there's one more key detail to the performance story of these new models that Apple hasn't revealed.

According to Xcode 27 (reported by MacRumors), both the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12 come with 4GB of memory.

Apple typically doesn't disclose memory specifications for the Apple Watch. But Xcode can reveal the relevant specs, which is quite useful for developers.

For reference, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Series 11 only had 2GB of memory.

That means this year's models have double the memory — a significant change that Apple has yet to officially announce or detail.
